summary: Added ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults in botocore/args.py, which maps client inputs to endpoint ruleset builtin parameter names (AWS::Region, AWS::UseFIPS, AWS::UseDualStack, SDK::Endpoint, AWS::STS::UseGlobalEndpoint, AWS::S3::UseGlobalEndpoint, AWS::S3::Accelerate, AWS::S3::ForcePathStyle, AWS::S3::UseArnRegion, AWS::S3Control::UseArnRegion). Added 13 unit tests in tests/unit/test_args.py; all pass. The full unit suite has 11 failures that are identical with and without the change (pre-existing). The method is not yet wired into get_client_args, matching the spec's unused-glue-code scope. Nothing was committed. tests/functional could not be collected because jsonschema is missing from the shared venv; I did not install it. The S3 UseArnRegion/S3Control defaults are fixed values because botocore has no config setting for them.
